set.workup: Ca2+ 6.2 mg/dL, phosphate 8.0, PTH low; lymphocytes 900/uL with very few T cells; chest film: no thymic shadow above the heart; echo: a conotruncal (outflow-tract) defect.

set.presentation: A 2-year-old boy adopted from abroad has always been small (weight under 3rd percentile) and tires quickly at play; when he cries his lips turn deep blue and he breathes fast. SpO2 84% at rest, clubbed fingers, RV lift; harsh 3/6 systolic ejection murmur at the left upper sternal border.
